name: Runner Extras - Report Metadata Loader
brief: Proves NavGlobal.MetadataProvider.GetReportMetadata(id) works for a report the runner source-compiles — not the precompiled-dependency stub-metadata case (see report-precompiled-dep-metadata), but the loader-null NRE in NCLMetaReport.LoadMetadata/GetMetadataFromLoader.
description: Regression test for RecordPatches.NclMetaFormReportBuilder.BuildNCLMetaReport passing loader=null to NCLMetaReport.CreateEmptyNCLMetaReport. Any AL surface that needs a report's real dataset/column shape (Report.WordXmlPart, Report.DefaultLayout, NavGlobal.MetadataProvider.GetReportMetadata(id) itself) calls NCLMetaReport.LoadMetadata() -> GetMetadataFromLoader() -> ObjectLoader.XmlMetadataLoader.GetMetaObjectXmlMetadata(...), which NREs when ObjectLoader is null. This report lives in THIS suite's own source (source-compiled by the runner, so AlReportMetadataRegistry has its real emit-captured metadata XML) — RunnerXmlMetadataLoader.cs wires a real loader backed by that registry so the lookup succeeds instead of crashing.
